system.effect:
Trigger: A Weather Condition created by you or an ally would be dissipated by a means other than Tier 3 Weather. 

Effect: You may spend X AP, where X is equal to the Tier of the Weather that would be dissipated. The Weather Condition doesn't dissipate and gains up to 3 additional rounds of duration to a maximum of the starting value of the weather. If the triggering condition was another due to another Tier 1 or Tier 2 Weather Condition being created, the Weather Condition instead attempts to overwrite the triggering Weather Condition. The Weather Condition is dissipated if it fails to overwrite the triggering Weather Condition in this way.
system.name: Climatology [CR]
